reviews.name: Osman
reviews.text:
📍In den Sommermonaten beginnen die Freitagsgebete um 14:30 Uhr.🤲

Das Naht- und Teravih-Gebet beginnt um 20:00 Uhr.

In der Nähe der Sportanlage kann man am Straßenrand leicht einen Parkplatz finden.

Nach dem Gebet wird Tee ☕ angeboten. 👍.
reviews.textTranslated:
📍During the summer months, Friday prayers begin at 2:30 PM.🤲

The Nahh and Teravih prayers begin at 8:00 PM.

Parking is readily available along the roadside near the sports complex.

Tea ☕ is served after the prayers. 👍

reviews.name: Hasan Sinan Koşmaz
reviews.text:
Sommerzeit beginnt Freitagsgebet mit dem Ezan um 14:30 Uhr, ab 14 Uhr ist die Tür spätestens geöffnet.

Winterzeit wird pünktlich das Freitagsgebet stattfinden.

Freitags Abend findet unser Vortrag auf Deutsch und Samstags Abend auf Türkisch statt.
reviews.textTranslated:
During summer time, Friday prayers begin with the Ezan at 2:30 p.m. The doors will be open no later than 2:00 p.m.

During winter time, Friday prayers will take place on time.

Our lectures are held in German on Friday evenings and in Turkish on Saturday evenings.

Camii biraz daha temiz tutulmalı.
Gün içinde birçok ziyaretçinin uğrak yeri olarak bilhassa ibadet yeri olarak camiye en azından irobot temizlik makinası alınabilir. Bunun dışında 5 vakit namaz için şehir merkezinde güzel bir alternatif.
reviews.textTranslated: The mosque should be kept a little cleaner. Given that it's a place frequented by many visitors throughout the day, especially as a place of worship, at least an iRobot cleaning machine could be acquired for the mosque. Apart from that, it's a nice alternative in the city center for five daily prayers.
reviews.responseFromOwnerText:
Vielen Dank für Ihr Feedback. Wir nehmen den Hinweis zur Sauberkeit ernst und werden prüfen, wie wir die Reinigung weiter verbessern können – auch durch technische Unterstützung, sofern sinnvoll.
Es freut uns, dass Sie die Moschee als zentrale Möglichkeit für die täglichen Gebete schätzen.

reviews.name: Fırat Çelik
reviews.text: Son haliyle çok daha güzel oldu. Dışarıya yeni halı serildi ve camekan ile kapatıldı. Böylelikle yeni alan açıldı ve ayakkabılık vs birçok şey yenilenmiş oldu. Camii şehrin tam merkezi konumunda ve abdest tuvalet yeri temiz. Tabii camiye gelenler bu temizlik hususunda hassas olmalı. Bunun dışında dışarıda serili olan halının çok daha temiz tutulmasına özen gösterilmeli. Çarşıdaki işleriniz sırasında namaz için gayet güzel bir ortam.. Ayrıca bayanlar içinde hemen girişte solda tarafta bir yer ayrılmış, ailece gelinebilir.
reviews.textTranslated: It looks much nicer in its final form. A new carpet was laid outside and it was enclosed with glass. This created new space and many things, such as the shoe rack, were renewed. The mosque is located right in the city center and the ablution and toilet areas are clean. Of course, those who come to the mosque should be sensitive about this cleanliness. In addition, care should be taken to keep the carpet laid outside much cleaner. It's a very nice environment for prayer while you're doing your shopping in the market. Also, there is a place reserved for women on the left side immediately at the entrance, so families can come.

Die Taqwa-Moschee im Zentrum von Frankfurt bietet tägliche Gebete, Freitagsgebet und religiöse Lehre. Sie ist wegen ihrer ruhigen, spirituellen Atmosphäre bei Gemeindemitgliedern sehr beliebt.
********************************************
يقع هذا المسجد في وسط فرانكفورت ويُعرف بجوه الهادئ وروحانيته، يوفر الصلوات اليومية، صلاة الجمعة ودروسًا دينية. يحظى بتقييمات إيجابية من زائريه من مختلف الأعمار والتوجهات
reviews.textTranslated:
The Taqwa Mosque in the center of Frankfurt offers daily prayers, Friday prayers, and religious lessons. It is very popular with the community for its peaceful and spiritual atmosphere.

********************************************
Located in the heart of Frankfurt, this mosque is known for its tranquil and spiritual atmosphere. It offers daily prayers, Friday prayers, and religious lessons. It receives positive reviews from visitors of all ages and backgrounds.
